name: toml-string-roundtrip
rationale: toml documents dumps as producing TOML corresponding to a Python dictionary and loads as parsing that TOML into a dictionary. TOML 0.5.0 permits valid Unicode scalar values in basic strings, with control characters escaped. Upstream tests/test_api.py includes roundtrip assertions. The adapter only wraps the generated string in a fixed-key dictionary and unwraps it after parsing.
domain: Python str values of length 0 through 64 generated by Hypothesis st.text with its default alphabet, which excludes surrogate code points. These are Unicode scalar values representable in TOML strings; control characters must be escaped by the serializer. No bytes, custom classes, mixed-type arrays, or invalid surrogate code points.
